name: Hurdle Run
author: Addicting Games
description: Hurdle Run is a free avoider game. Some people have the audacity to end their running. We are here to tell you all about a world where you never have to end your trot. This is the world of endless runners. An endless runner game is a game that never ends so long as you maintain your ability to run. That sounds easy, doesn't it? You just run and keep collecting points. But the problem, in this case, is that there are obstacles. that is right, obstacles! You're going to have to jump over these randomly placed hurdles if you wish to keep running. The sky is the limit in this game if you are able to make it all the way all of the time. You will need to run, jump, run and keep going. Become the king and or queen of the leaderboard as you dodge hurdles and run as fast as you can for as long as you can. You'll show them all as long as you can keep your feet on the ground your head in the air and all the hurdles life throws your way behind you.
